Thread renders 'down' on 10/10 rows while ws_summary.thread_alive=True and every wallet's last_message_ms advances (stale_ms 409..4370074). Per-wallet thread_alive/worker_thread_alive is absent, so the boolean default reads as a dead worker.

Last close/error renders an empty string on 10/10 rows. Renderer reads last_error_repr/last_error/last_close_msg; the served object carries last_error only (['last_error', 'last_message_ms', 'stale', 'stale_ms']) and the serving health writer never emits last_close_msg, so no close/error can surface. Empty on every row is also not row-bound.
